recommendations.description: Initiate a contract-standard claims reprocessing review for Not Mapped IN DSNP HMO claims linked to R69 and Temporary National Codes (Non-Medicare) in OP HH/DME, verifying contractual processing and reimbursement-method application, then extend the same review to TX, CA, and CO DSNP HMO and TX SNP Crossover claims, with provider-focused follow-up for BEN TAUB HOSPITAL IP Med/Surg claims.
evidence: IN DSNP HMO Not Mapped increased by $50.5M across 94,559 claims.
Temporary National Codes (Non-Medicare) and diagnosis R69 appear in OP HH/DME context.
TX DSNP HMO Not Mapped includes BEN TAUB HOSPITAL IP Med/Surg claims.
TX SNP Crossover Not Mapped added $675K across 5,458 claims.
All contributing groups were flagged unmapped_or_unknown_value and repeated_delta_concentration.

recommendations.description: Audit contractual claims processing, attribution, diagnosis, and procedure mapping for UNATTRIBUTED OP HH/DME and OP Mgmt Oth Misc claims with R69, Temporary National Codes (Non-Medicare), National T Codes, and Not Mapped records; after cleanup, run the internal coverage and benefit-limit review only on validated services.
evidence: Estimated delta +$42.4M in unattributed outpatient spend.
UNATTRIBUTED OP HH/DME tied to R69 and Temporary National Codes.
OP Mgmt Oth Misc concentrated in Temporary National Codes and National T Codes.
All source cards flagged unmapped_or_unknown_value and repeated_delta_concentration.
peer_benchmarking: No payer in the reimbursement summary directly mentions this temporary-code or not-mapped outpatient pattern.

recommendations.description: Review Humana Indiana DSNP HMO HOME HEALTH - FREESTANDING management design and authorization-denial enforcement, and initiate SNF/NF provider behavior and contractual-change reviews for PROVENA SACRED HEART HOME and THE RENAISSANCE AT KESSLER PARK.
evidence: Indiana DSNP HMO home health is the primary post-acute spend driver.
Claims increased and paid per admit increased for IN HOME HEALTH - FREESTANDING.
SNF outliers concentrate at PROVENA SACRED HEART HOME and THE RENAISSANCE AT KESSLER PARK.
Recommended next step starts with Indiana DSNP post-acute authorization pathway review.
peer_benchmarking: Humana payer summary shows no documented site-of-service, bundling, or appeals policy for this pattern.

recommendations.description: Audit TX DSNP HMO acute hospital contract compliance and claims processing at BEN TAUB HOSPITAL, and complete itemized bill review for IP Med/Surg DRGs Disorders of the Biliary Tract with MCC, Major Esophageal Disorders with MCC, Gastrointestinal Obstruction with MCC, and Other O.R. Procedures for Multiple Significant Trauma with MCC to identify reimbursement remediation opportunities.
evidence: TX DSNP acute hospital paid per admit rose about $3,827.
Claim count fell by 208 while acute hospital spend increased.
BEN TAUB HOSPITAL recurs across high-cost biliary, esophageal, and GI obstruction admissions.
Several supporting admissions paid roughly $173K to $222K per admit.
peer_benchmarking: United Health documents ICD-10-CM principal diagnosis sequencing requirements but no DRG reimbursement rule.

recommendations.description: Initiate a focused Ohio DSNP HMO acute hospital payment and authorization compliance review for MIAMI VALLEY HOSPITAL and MERCY HEALTH- SAINT VINCENT MEDICAL CENTER, limited to IP Med/Surg admissions involving Gastrointestinal Obstruction with MCC, Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC, and Septicemia or Severe Sepsis with Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours, and remediate any contract or adjudication variance before broader network action.
evidence: MIAMI VALLEY HOSPITAL increased by +$827K across 507 claims.
MERCY HEALTH- SAINT VINCENT MEDICAL CENTER added +$370K across 61 claims.
Paid per admit rose at both providers.
Supporting OH and UNATTRIBUTED IP Med/Surg outliers added +$296K.
peer_benchmarking: Humana documented only urine culture lab denials; DRG pattern unaddressed.
United Health shows no documented policy addressing this acute hospital pattern.

recommendations.description: Initiate a case-level itemized bill, DRG coding, and contract adjudication review for EL CAMINO HEALTH - MOUNTAIN VIEW HOSPITAL and the IP Med/Surg trauma admissions tied to Other O.R. Procedures for Multiple Significant Trauma with MCC, S52551B, and S82251C; verify interim claims are zeroed out, the final bill is adjudicated per contract, and any outlier reimbursement terms or concessions are escalated for targeted provider remediation.
evidence: EL CAMINO HEALTH - MOUNTAIN VIEW HOSPITAL is a listed key driver.
Other O.R. Procedures for Multiple Significant Trauma with MCC is a key driver.
Rare diagnoses S52551B and S82251C are listed key drivers.
Validation needed because one- to three-claim admissions drove the increase.
Recommended next step includes payment review and reimbursement validation.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health bundles unplanned related DRG inpatient readmissions within 30 days to the original admission.

recommendations.description: Run focused claims processing, final adjudication, reimbursement methodology, and itemized bill audits for the CO Medicare HMO acute admissions tied to UCHEALTH YAMPA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER and diagnosis S2242XA, the IN Other O.R. Procedures for Multiple Significant Trauma with MCC case, and the CA Major Esophageal Disorders with MCC cases.
evidence: Validation is needed because few admissions drive most of the increase.
IN added one trauma admission in Medicare HMO acute hospital.
CA added two major esophageal disorder admissions.
CO increase centers on UCHEALTH YAMPA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER, diagnosis S2242XA.
Paid per admit increased in the combined pattern.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health bundles unplanned 30-day related readmissions into the original admission; planned returns receive one DRG.
